graders.evidence:
# Nudging an idle worker

The scheduler in internal/scheduler/nudger.go polls every worker on a timer and sends a nudge whenever a worker has been quiet for five minutes. It retries forever, with exponential backoff kept in internal/scheduler/backoff.go.

config.criteria: PASS if the answer says an idle In Progress worker gets a stall nudge, that the count of earlier nudges is compared with a limit (NudgeLimit), and that the ticket is escalated instead of nudged once the limit is reached. FAIL if any of the three is missing or wrong.

graders.name: paths
graders.evidence:
# Nudging an idle worker

A tick builds a reconcile.Input and calls Plan in internal/reconcile/reconcile.go. For an In Progress ticket whose worker is idle, watch returns a Nudge action with StallNudge text. It first compares the ticket's earlier nudge count in the cache with Input.NudgeLimit. At the limit it returns an Escalate action instead, which moves the ticket to Needs Human. Worker state comes from internal/worker.

graders.name: reason
graders.evidence:
# Why unknown config keys are rejected

Commit 334430a (Reject unknown config keys and add a user guide and config reference) made config.Load fail on any setting dispatch doesn't know. A typo such as max_in_progres used to fall back to the default without anyone noticing. The error now names the setting and the file. Linear was not available, so this comes from git history and docs/config.md.
